messages:
Liam (AE): Heads up: big POC blocked. Customer's JSON validator fails with 'Extra data' during function_call. Demo in 2 hours. Can we triage? :sweat:
Zara (SE): On it. Which model/flags and any snippet?
Liam (AE): Hosted rw-infer-2.1-xl, function_call with json_mode=strict, streaming=chunked. They pasted this sanitized payload:
```
{"tool_out": "{\"user_id\":\"U-777\", \"status\":\"ok\"}"} TRAILER: debug=on
```
Parser error: JSONDecodeError: Extra data at pos 56
Kofi (Eng): Looks like a trailer appended after the JSON object. Quick options: 1) client workaround: extract first JSON blob with a regex before strict parse; 2) enable tenant-scoped sanitizer to strip trailing bytes after the top-level closing brace. I can enable opt-in sanitizer for Dedicated immediately and for Hosted tenant in ~40m after approvals.
Megan (SRE): Correlating logs: small spike of 502 then 429 backoffs at 2027-01-15T11:02Z for that tenant pool, route=fallback-compat noted. Request IDs: rq_aa21..., rq_aa22...; collecting traces now.
InfraBot: Auto-note: quota bump request filed for tenant, escalation level=customer-urgent.
Zara (SE): Customer wants a server-side fix. Kofi can we do a narrow change that only strips trailing bytes and logs when truncation happens? Non-destructive preferred.
Kofi (Eng): Yes, we will implement a tenant flag that trims after first balanced JSON object and emits an audit event with request_id and bytes_removed. Patch ETA 30-45m. Will also add a short-term test to ensure no other customers affected.
Megan (SRE): Also recommend we update retry/fallback logic so retries preserve json_mode. I'll open a bug and attach traces.
Liam (AE): I'll tell the customer: apology, temp client snippet, we're enabling opt-in sanitizer with ETA ~40m, and offer credits if demo impacted. Need SOC2 link — I have it. Zara will draft the message, Kofi review. Back with updates in 45m. :thumbsup:
